summary.text: Mike Fési is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 20 (Lafourche and Terrebonne parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official Senate member page. He is vice chair of the Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Fési has worked in the oil and gas industry for more than 30 years, according to his Senate biography.
He is the founder and chairman of Pipeline Construction & Maintenance, Inc., an oil and gas industry service company that has operated out of Houma for more than 20 years.
He and his wife, Carla, have four children and eleven grandchildren and are active members of Bayou Blue Assembly of God Church.

The page lists committee assignments including Natural Resources (vice chair), Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Finance, Senate and Governmental Affairs, and the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
